description: This file defines the GreaterEqualBinary class used for rendering a 'greater than or equal to' binary expression in Twig templates, including compilation logic based on PHP version.

classes.name: Twig\Node\Expression\Binary\GreaterEqualBinary
classes.description: Represents a 'greater than or equal to' binary expression node within Twig's expression AST.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the greater-than-or-equal binary expression into PHP code, with different logic depending on PHP version.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the operator symbol for this binary expression, which is '>='.
